in_marathi.name: Dhinesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of riches
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhinesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhinesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Dhanvantari, who is considered the god of wealth and healing. The name is believed to bring prosperity and abundance in all aspects of life.
